subject: Launch subsidy — pilot credits and invoice plan
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@orbitstart.org>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot cohort — request for larger launch subsidy and invoice option

Hi Ben (and Irene),

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at OrbitStart is excited about Redwood for our accelerator cohort launching in July. We have a quick ask:

- Our standard promo covers $5k credits but the cohort (12 startups) will likely consume >$20k in the first 8 weeks.
- Would Redwood consider a one-time launch subsidy or increased promo credits for this pilot? If we can get a bigger credit or an invoiced subsidy, we can commit to a 6-month pilot (we'll track usage and share metrics).
- Also looking for a simple invoice (net30) option to cover the subsidy so we can pay Redwood and apply it against usage rather than have startups manage billing individually.

Happy to share cohort size and expected token profiles. Is this something you can approve or take to finance?

Thanks,
Emma Li
Partnerships, OrbitStart Labs
emma@orbitstart.org
+1 415-555-0127

--
OrbitStart Labs — accelerator supporting early-stage developer startups
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@orbitstart.org>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot cohort — request for larger launch subsidy and invoice option

Hi Emma — great to hear. I think we can get creative here. Short answer: we can offer a blended approach but need internal sign-off for any subsidy beyond our standard $5k promo.

Options I can propose now (subject to finance approval):
1) One-time invoice credit: Redwood issues an invoice for the agreed subsidy amount, OrbitStart pays net30, and we apply the credit to the account(s) as usage deductibles.
2) Increased promo credit: Move from $5k to $15k total credits for the cohort, applied centrally (we'd need an account-level promo code).
3) Discounted committed tier: If OrbitStart commits to a minimum $X/month for 6 months, we can add a % discount across that period in lieu of upfront credits.

I'll loop in Marissa (Finance) and Irene (Partnerships lead) to check feasibility and draft an invoice if needed. Can you send a quick estimate of expected token/month for the cohort?

I'll follow up shortly with next steps.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot cohort — request for larger launch subsidy and invoice option

Ben / Irene — looping in finance ops notes:

We can support option (1) or (2) but need to keep subsidy policy clear for precedent. Proposed pragmatic approach:
- Offer a one-time invoice credit of $10,000 (redwood payable invoice) to OrbitStart. We will issue Invoice #ORBIT-3489 for $10,000 (net30) and apply it as an account-level credit across the 12 cohort accounts.
- Additionally grant a promo code for $5,000 in incremental free credits (so total benefit = $15k).
- Contractually, include a pilot terms addendum: 6-month pilot, Redwood to receive usage metrics, and Redwood reserves right to revert to standard pricing after pilot unless a follow-on agreement is signed.

If OrbitStart prefers an increased promo-credit-only route, we can do $15k promo, but that has higher risk exposure. Invoice-credit is cleaner for internal tracking and is preferred.

Irene: please confirm that partnerships ok to proceed; if yes I will prepare the invoice draft and the promo code. Need a signed contact or PO from OrbitStart to attach to the invoice.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma@orbitstart.org>
Date: 2026-05-30 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot cohort — request for larger launch subsidy and invoice option

Marissa — that plan works for Partnerships. Couple of clarifications before we proceed:
- Confirm we will limit usage to the 12 enrolled accounts and that the promo code is single-use per account (so it cannot be shared outside the cohort).
- Please add a line in the addendum that Redwood retains right to sample/pseudonymize usage for quality monitoring — no PII extraction.
- Finance: confirm the ledger treatment (one-time promotional marketing expense vs. revenue deferral).

Emma — if OrbitStart can provide a PO or a signed email confirming the cohort list and acceptance of the pilot terms, we can issue the invoice and promo codes by EOD tomorrow.

I approve the one-time invoice-credit of $10k + $5k promo credit if the above protections are included.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@orbitstart.org>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-31 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot cohort — request for larger launch subsidy and invoice option

Emma — thank you for the quick reply and the PO (attached). Confirming next steps:

- Redwood will issue Invoice #ORBIT-3489 for $10,000 (net30). Once paid, we will apply the $10k as an account-level credit distributed across the 12 cohort accounts.
- We will also provision a one-time promo code worth $5,000 that will be single-use, account-bound for each cohort company.
- Addendum: 6-month pilot; Redwood may sample telemetry for quality (no PII); promo limited to cohort accounts.
- Attached: OrbitStart_MAAP_intro.pdf (your cohort summary we received) and invoice-draft-ORBIT-3489.pdf for your review.

Please confirm acceptance and estimated payment date so finance can finalize. Once payment posts, I'll send the promo codes and onboarding guide.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachments: OrbitStart_MAAP_intro.pdf (application/pdf), invoice-draft-ORBIT-3489.pdf (application/pdf)
